lines.speaker: Ashgrave
lines.text: Four hundred years, and my first guests are the devil's errand runners.

lines.speaker: Ashgrave
lines.text: I'm Ashgrave. I led the Watch, I made the bargain, and yes, I broke it.

lines.speaker: Ashgrave
lines.text: Azhrakel would have burned the world clean of everything that lives. I took enough of its fire to keep it asleep, and I have held its door shut from in here ever since.

lines.speaker: Ashgrave

lines.speaker: Ashgrave

lines.speaker: Azhrakel

lines.speaker: Azhrakel
lines.text: The Betrayer is dead. As I promised: my fire is yours, three times over. Now go, and remember who you serve.

lines.speaker: Azhrakel
lines.text: Good. Through the fire, then. He waits for you in his Hollow Keep.

lines.speaker: Azhrakel
lines.text: A spark... and a heart. The little ones bring me gifts.

lines.speaker: Azhrakel
lines.text: I am Azhrakel. I was burning before your kind learned fire, and I have slept beneath your walls four hundred years.

lines.speaker: Azhrakel
lines.text: One of you was clever once. Corvin Ashgrave. He bowed, he swore, and then he stole from me and ran to a place even I cannot reach.

lines.speaker: Azhrakel
lines.text: So choose. Raise your weapons against me and win, and I will give you my brand and my blood. Or serve me: go where I cannot, and bring me the Betrayer's death.

lines.speaker: Azhrakel
lines.text: Enough... enough! You have won. Take my brand, and take my blood. Let the world burn a little brighter in your hands.

lines.speaker: Brannock

lines.speaker: Morrow

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Yes! Can you feel the floor humming? The core remembers what it was made for.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Halfway. Vale called this a battery. A battery! It is a heart, and it is starting to beat.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Almost there. Keep them coming. Don't let them near the glass!

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Listen to it sing. The Lantern is awake, for the first time in eleven years.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Vale only ever wanted a battery. I wanted a door. And you have just knocked on it.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Take the spark from the core. Careful, it bites. It is alive, but empty. My old altar in the Archives can fill it, once its four relics are back where they belong. The monks hid them in the Chapel and the Sunken Temple.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Ahh... hands on my Lantern. Warm hands. Living hands. How long has it been?

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Don't be frightened. I am Ignatius Morrow. I built this machine, long before Vale put his name on it.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: You want to know what it is for? My primal goal, my one true work: to burn death out of the world. Forever.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: But the Lantern is cold, and it is hungry. Feed it the dead. Fifty of them should wake it. I've sealed the doors, so nobody wanders off.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: A third of the way. The spark is drinking. Can you hear it humming?

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Two minutes! It's brighter than I ever managed on my own.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Nearly full. Don't let them touch the stone!

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Full. Full of mana! Take it, quickly, before it cools.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: There was a man who knew what a charged spark was really for. The Watch kept a post in the Crane Yard. If any of them still breathe, find him.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Wait. The water's moving. Something sleeps under that idol, and you've just taken its toys.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: The doors have sealed! Kill it, or you're not leaving that temple.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: It's dead? Good. The doors are open. Bring those relics to me before anything else crawls out of the water.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: It dragged the relics back into the water. Pick them up again when you're ready, and this time, keep your feet.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: All four are home. Now lay the spark on the altar, and whatever happens, don't leave the room.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: A relic! The monks hid them well. Bring all four to my altar in the Archives.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: The circle is whole. Put the spark on the stone. Gently now.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: The monks of the Scriptorium filled their lamps here with mana, the old word for what runs under everything. It takes time, and the dead can smell it.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: Three minutes. Stay in the Archives and keep them off the altar. If the room empties, the ritual stalls.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: You've opened it. Do you understand what you've done? ...No. Go on. I want to see it too.

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: What are you doing? No, no, not the garden! That circle was sealed for a reason!

lines.speaker: Morrow
lines.text: A god, beaten! My door is open, and the dead have a new reason to fear us. Thank you, my friends. Thank you.

lines.text: Can anyone hear me? This is Dispatch, facility security. Good, you're awake.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: This is the last of it. Hold this round and the lift reaches the surface. Hold it.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: You're doing better than the last team. Much better.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I'm putting your orders on your suit display. Check it whenever you're lost.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Ignore the warning labels. Nobody who wrote them is coming back.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Kills buy you everything down there. The doors, the wall guns, all of it still runs on facility credit.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: That's the generator! I've got lights on the board. Every door in the facility is live now.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The Lantern doesn't stop the dead. It makes them. And every round you survive feeds it.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I'm making you an offer, one last time. Stay. Keep the Lantern burning and I'll keep you alive forever.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: There's a containment core down there. The staff called it the Lantern. It's nothing you need to worry about.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Fine. Take your reward.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Someone's put sabotage jobs on your board. They didn't come from me.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: That relay was expensive.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The yards and the depot should still have weapons lockers. Open the doors if you can afford it.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Every job you finish costs me something. You know that?

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: ...You've cracked the core. It's leaking everywhere now.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Good work. Credits are on their way.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: New jobs on your board. Credits for anyone who finishes them.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I'm losing the grid! Emergency lights only. They hunt better in the dark.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The Lantern is drawing almost everything you restore. That's expected. Keep the power coming.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Find all three numbers and punch them into the panel by the generator. Then I can open the exits.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Lantern at full charge. Thank you. Truly. You have no idea how long I've waited for a team like you.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Job done. That's the kind of team I need.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Fine. The surface lift is real, and it's at the bottom of the old shaft. I'm sealing every other door. Let's see how far you get.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Nicely done. The Lantern... the grid appreciates it.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Three new jobs. Don't wander off the list.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I won't stop you. I don't think I can. Go, before I change my mind about the door.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Heavy signature incoming. Don't let it corner you.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I see what's on your board now. Stop it.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Somebody left parts for the old field kits lying around. Get them to a workbench and you can build something useful.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: More jobs. The facility pays well when you do as you're told.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: ...The lift is through. Daylight. You actually did it. The Lantern's gone dark.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: You were never meant to leave. You were meant to keep it charged.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Why haven't the exits opened? Patience. There's one more thing I need from you.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: You're making this harder than it needs to be. I could open a door for you. Just one. Stop pulling cables and it's yours.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I can hear the cracks in the core from here. Please stop.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Readings from Sublevel 9 are going up every time you clear a wave. It's probably interference.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: This is Vale. Facility-wide lockdown is in effect. Nobody leaves. Including the dead.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Signal lost. I'll wake the next team.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: Another team gone. The Lantern thanks you for your contribution.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The lift needs power to climb, and the only power left is what you make down there. Every round you clear lifts it a floor.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The Lantern is unstable. Do you understand what happens to the people standing next to it when it breaks?

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The power's out on every level and the containment doors failed. Those things out there used to be staff.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: So close. The shaft keeps whoever falls in it.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: I've marked three jobs for you. Do them and I'll make it worth your while.
